### D004

**Photo File Format**

Msetter: File format. DNG is the raw file. JPG is ready to share.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 0 (DNG)
- Cameras: all

| Value | Camera's name |
|---|---|
| 0 | DNG |
| 1 | DNG + JPG |
| 2 | JPG |

### D196

**Photo DNG Resolution**

Msetter: DNG size. Smaller files hold fewer pixels.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 0 (L-DNG (60 MP))
- Cameras: all

| Value | Camera's name |
|---|---|
| 0 | L-DNG (60 MP) |
| 1 | M-DNG (36 MP) |
| 2 | S-DNG (18 MP) |

### D00F

**Photo JPG Resolution Max.**

Msetter: JPG size. Smaller files hold fewer pixels.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 3 (L-JPG (60 MP))
- Cameras: all

| Value | Camera's name |
|---|---|
| 3 | L-JPG (60 MP) |
| 4 | M-JPG (36 MP) |
| 5 | S-JPG (18 MP) |

### D017

**Storage Options**

Msetter: Storage. IN is the camera’s own memory.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 7 (DNG+JPG first on SD)
- Cameras: all

IN is the camera's internal memory, SD the card (M-EV1 manual p.72).

| Value | Camera's name |
|---|---|
| 7 | DNG+JPG first on SD |
| 6 | DNG+JPG first on IN |
| 11 | DNG on SD / JPG on IN |
| 8 | DNG on IN / JPG on SD |
| 5 | DNG+JPG on IN=SD |
| 9 | DNG+JPG only on SD |

### D002

**Edit Filename**

Msetter: File names start with. Three letters or numbers.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: text of exactly 3 characters
- Factory value: "L10"
- Cameras: all

Three characters at the start of every file name. The M-EV1 manual says lower-case letters are not available (p.76).

### D019

**Folder name**

Msetter: Folder name. Five letters or numbers. The camera puts a number in front, as in 100LEICA.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: text of exactly 5 characters
- Factory value: "LEICA"
- Cameras: all

The five letters of the folder name, as in 100LEICA.

### D02F

**Copyright Information**

Msetter: Copyright in files. Writes Artist and Copyright into your pictures.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 0 (Off)
- Cameras: all

Writes the Artist and Copyright texts into each picture. Described in the M11 manual (p.82).

| Value | Camera's name |
|---|---|
| 0 | Off |
| 1 | On |

### 501E

**Artist**

Msetter: Artist. Up to 20 characters.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: text of 0 to 20 characters
- Factory value: "" (empty)
- Cameras: all

Up to 20 characters. The M-EV1 manual shows it as Produced by, under Leica Content Credentials (p.76).

### 501F

**Copyright**

Msetter: Copyright. Up to 20 characters.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: text of 0 to 20 characters
- Factory value: "" (empty)
- Cameras: all

Up to 20 characters. The M-EV1 manual shows it under Leica Content Credentials (p.76).

### D21C

**Content Credentials**

Msetter: Content Credentials. Signs each picture so anyone can check where it came from.

- Scope: per profile, seven slots
- Kind: one of a list of numbers
- Factory value: 1 (On)
- Cameras: the M11-P, M11-D and M-EV1; not the M11 or M11 Monochrom

Signs each picture with Leica Content Credentials (M-EV1 manual p.76).

| Value | Camera's name |
|---|---|
| 0 | Off |
| 1 | On |
